name: Session-handoff ORB — 30m break with ATR-scaled stop (session-anchored)
rationale: MECHANISM: same session-handoff flow as the 15m variant (overnight range re-priced at the US open; hedging desks chase the break, overnight faders are the counterparty) but expressed on a 30m bar with an ATR-multiple stop instead of a fixed-fraction stop. The coarser bar halves trade count (less fee drag) and the ATR stop sizes risk to realized volatility so a wide-range US-open bar is not stopped on noise. Entry: session-anchored opening-range breakout (setup.orb anchor='session') gated by adx and a positive range_position (price already pressing the top of its recent range, confirming the break is into strength). DISCONFIRMER: kill if a fixed-stop version lives while this ATR version dies (edge would be in the risk overlay, not the handoff), or if anchor='rolling' nets the same (session timing curve-fit). Also kill if it fails DSR 0.95 net of fees.
catalyst: US session open breaking the overnight range with volatility-scaled risk
